messages:
maria: heads-up — Deploybot queued a catalog enable for quasar-13b-quantv2 in the 03/25 change window (UTC). need pinlist, fallback ordering, and autoscale knobs reviewed. link: https://confluence.redwood/quasar-enable

deploybot: Deploy queued: quasar-13b-quantv2 -> scheduled 2025-03-25T02:00Z. Preconditions: preflight pass required, canary=5% for 30m, fallback variants configured. react with :white_check_mark: to ack.

sam: pinging telemetry/obs — we need token-cost and p50/p95 latency baselines for current default model vs quantv2 before canary. can you prepare a short diff?

lee: infra note — quantv2 increases memory usage on host pools by ~10% in our perf runs. Suggest autoscale.min_replicas +1 for the initial 24h. I can prewarm a small pool in APAC to avoid cold-start noise.

nina: SRE checklist: define rollback triggers (errors, latency, cost delta). propose: >1.5x p95 or errors spike >3x sustained for 10m -> auto-rollback to pinned variant. Also need alert runbook link.

oliver: QA preflight done locally. Found a small tokenization drift on a subset of prompts (edge-case system prompts). Not blocking for canary but added to regression set. PR with unit test: https://github.com/redwood/qa/pull/842

aya: product: canary plan: 5% for 30m, 25% for 2h if no regressions, then 100% rollout over 48h. Customer-facing release note drafted here: https://docs.redwood/release/quasar-quantv2-draft. Please review wording around cost expectations.

maria: pinlist suggestion: keep current default (quasar-13b) as primary fallback, then quasar-13b-quantv1, then quasar-12b if needed. ordering rationale: compatibility then quant family. Also adding a soft-ttl of 60s on fallback so we avoid immediate oscillation.

lee: noted on soft-ttl. Also enabling adaptive-batch for canary to reduce perf variance. I'll push autoscale change to staging: autoscale.min=3 -> 4, burst=+2.

sam: obs will produce the pre/post diff report by EOD PST. will include cost-per-token estimate and sample latency histograms.

nina: runbook link: https://runbooks/redwood/rollbacks/quasar-enable — added rollback steps and who to call. recommending manual hold at 25% gate.

oliver: QA will run the regression suite against canary pool ASAP. ETA 2h. Adding the failing tokenization case to the canary prompt set.

aya: product ok with rollback triggers and suggested rollout cadence. product@redwood will notify customers in the 6h preannounce.

maria: final checklist before ops window: 1) obs report uploaded 2) autoscale change deployed to canary cluster 3) pinlist committed to catalog 4) deploybot preflight green. tagging @deploybot for final preflight.

deploybot: Preflight started. Checking: model artifact signature, pinlist present, telemetry hook registered, canary routing rules. Current status: artifact OK, pinlist found, telemetry hook missing — blocking.

sam: telemetry hook was behind an infra flag, flipping now. will post when hook is live.

sam: telemetry hook live. deploybot: re-run preflight please.

deploybot: Preflight passed. Canary route created (5%): quasar-13b-quantv2. Schedule remains 2025-03-25T02:00Z. To abort or change, respond with `abort` or `reschedule <iso>` in this thread.

maria: :white_check_mark: all acked from eng-releases. will start the change window runbook at 01:45Z for final ops sync.

aya: leaving a note — if we see 10%+ cost-per-token increase at 5% canary, hold and escalate to product + eng.

nina: agreed. I'll monitor and have pager rotation on standby for the window.

maria: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source during the window.
